items.title: John LaPorta interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 13, 1996
items.q: Not all of them were doing it, but drummers like Jo Jones, Dave Tough was playing more along those lines.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well there was, it was the first white band I think that got into what black bands were doing. Not all of them were doing it, but drummers like Jo Jones, Dave Tough was playing more along those lines. The best way I can describe it is prior to that time the majority of drummers were trying to make it happen, just almost like putting in a ring through your nose you know and forcing everybody to play the time you know. And there is something to be said for that and they can get into a good swinging thing, but…
